billing.note: charged_credits is what the customer was billed for this run, from the ledger, capped at budget_credits. Report these numbers, not usage.*_usd.

pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

comment.comment:
Congratulations you are early to the most likely meme of this cycle. 

The question now is - Can you go back through the early charts of other cycle runners PEPE SHIB WIF BONK etc and TRULY ask yourself if you have the diamond handed delusion to hold a meme through all of that?
The pumps, the dumps, the obituaries, the seemingly endless doubt, the capitulation, the euphoria…

It will all return with Jeanphil and your first priority being this early should be to do some serious work mentally/daily meditation to detach yourself emotionally from the number of your port on the screen.
It will stop you from dwindling your stack on the early pumps, or capitulating on any dumps (because they will continue on the ride to 1b+).

I have a strong inclination this meme will make many millionaires, and even more people will
fumble the bag too early.

If you are not positioned - the difference between buying sub 3m or sub 10m really won’t matter in the end.
If you are positioned - great. Now delete your fomo app and go work on yourself and enjoy life.
Because Jeanphil needs time to cook, don’t let a need to rotate and chase (gambling let’s be honest) let you fumble this one.

I love you all and will see you at $1b
Oui madame

comment.comment:
SI Isn't Dead — It's Becoming Institutional. Don't Let a Few Red Days Shake You Out.

A lot of people are asking if SI died after the election. The last three days say the opposite:

1. Trump himself brought it back on Nov. 6, with a stronger frame.
"I am 100% in favour of Super Intelligence (SI)… They are GOLD." This isn't just about changing a word anymore — he's tying SI to data centers, jobs, and state wealth. That's a much harder narrative to kill.

2. The DOJ launched a Super Intelligence Task Force on Nov. 5.
Led by Woodward and Weiss, working with SI Force Chair Jay Clayton, focused on foreign actors, transnational crime, and fraud abusing SI. That's SI written into a permanent law-enforcement body — the first time since the executive order. Reports say it also absorbed the DOJ's AI Task Force from January.

3. Even the opposition is now fighting over "superintelligence."
On Nov. 4, Rep. Ansari called for banning artificial superintelligence (ASI). Different word, opposite direction — but nobody is debating whether the concept matters anymore. They're fighting over who defines it.

What's next:

Nov. 9 — Congress reconvenes; OpenAI's "speed limits" push begins
Nov. 18–19 — APEC in Shenzhen; U.S.–China SI Dialogue due by end of November
Nov. 28 — Federal SI definition draft due — the first chance for SI to get a legal definition
SI was never going to be decided by one day's price action. Sept. 29 was the executive order. Nov. 5 was the DOJ. Nov. 6 was the President reaffirming it himself. Next is Nov. 28.

The word didn't fade. It's being institutionalized. Hold the line.
